```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-2 (Patient Appointment File)
Conditions:
- Appointment Type: Scheduled | Rescheduled | Cancelled
- Patient Status: Active | Inactive | Archived
Actions:
- Create File: Yes | No
Rules:
1. Scheduled, Active → Create File: Yes
2. Rescheduled, Active → Create File: Yes
3. Cancelled, Active → Create File: No
4. Any, Inactive → Create File: No
5. Any, Archived → Create File: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-3 (Workflow Routing to Doctors)
Conditions:
- Consultation Type: General | Specialized
- Doctor Availability: Available | Unavailable
- Patient Preference: Same Doctor | Any Doctor
Actions:
- Route to Doctor: Yes | No
Rules:
1. General, Available, Same Doctor → Route to Doctor: Yes
2. General, Unavailable, Same Doctor → Route to Doctor: No
3. Specialized, Available, Any Doctor → Route to Doctor: Yes
4. Specialized, Unavailable, Any Doctor → Route to Doctor: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-4 (Routing to Chemist and Labs)
Conditions:
- Patient Pincode: Matches Chemist | Does Not Match
- Chemist Availability: Available | Unavailable
- Lab Pincode: Matches Lab | Does Not Match
- Lab Availability: Available | Unavailable
Actions:
- Route to Chemist: Yes | No
- Route to Lab: Yes | No
Rules:
1. Matches Chemist, Available → Route to Chemist: Yes
2. Does Not Match, Available → Route to Chemist: No
3. Matches Lab, Available → Route to Lab: Yes
4. Does Not Match, Available → Route to Lab: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-5 (ML Algorithm for Disease Prediction)
Conditions:
- Symptom Set Completeness: Complete | Incomplete
- Training Data Availability: Available | Not Available
- Model Confidence: High | Low
Actions:
- Predict Disease: Yes | No
Rules:
1. Complete, Available, High → Predict Disease: Yes
2. Complete, Not Available, High → Predict Disease: No
3. Incomplete, Available, Low → Predict Disease: No
4. Incomplete, Not Available, Low → Predict Disease: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-6 (Continuous Training of ML Algorithm)
Conditions:
- New Data Set Availability: Yes | No
- Model Performance: Improving | Deteriorating
Actions:
- Retrain Model: Yes | No
Rules:
1. Yes, Improving → Retrain Model: Yes
2. Yes, Deteriorating → Retrain Model: Yes
3. No, Improving → Retrain Model: No
4. No, Deteriorating → Retrain Model: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-7 (Database Maintenance)
Conditions:
- Maintenance Request Type: Backup | Update | Repair
- Administration Status: Available | Unavailable
Actions:
- Perform Maintenance: Yes | No
Rules:
1. Backup, Available → Perform Maintenance: Yes
2. Update, Available → Perform Maintenance: Yes
3. Repair, Available → Perform Maintenance: Yes
4. Any, Unavailable → Perform Maintenance: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-8 (Archiving Inactive Patients)
Conditions:
- Consultation Frequency: >3 Years | ≤3 Years
Actions:
- Archive Patient: Yes | No
Rules:
1. ≤3 Years → Archive Patient: Yes
2. >3 Years → Archive Patient: No

Decision Table for Requirement VIRTUA-2.5-9 (Consultation Request Volume)
Conditions:
- Weekly Requests: <25,000 | ≥25,000
- Yearly Requests: <1.3M | ≥1.3M
Actions:
- System Performance: Adequate | Overloaded
Rules:
1. ≥25,000, ≥1.3M → System Performance: Overloaded
2. <25,000, <1.3M → System Performance: Adequate
```
